reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) concerns transformation-induced plasticity in a VCrFeCoNi medium-entropy alloy and inverse Hall-Petch/amorphization in CoCrFeMnNi, neither of which addresses grain refinement, irradiation defect sinks, or high-temperature stability in refractory BCC NbMoTaW.
